Hi Sam — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Thanks for sending the questionnaire.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (current through 2026) — I can share the redacted report via a secure link once we confirm terms for sharing.
- HIPAA/PHI: We support HIPAA workloads under a BAA; Redwood can sign a BAA and we have customers processing PHI.
- PHI processing: By default our hosted offering does not ingest PHI unless a customer explicitly configures it and signs a BAA — please confirm whether AcmeHealth plans to send PHI or protected health information in any requests.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm scope (will PHI be included?) — this determines which questions need full detail and whether we need legal/BAA paperwork.
2) I'll start populating the SIG spreadsheet and loop in our security lead (Neha) and Customer Success (Marissa) for coverage on controls and operational questions.
3) If you need the SOC 2 report, let me know the secure transfer method (SFTP/url) and I will get it uploaded.

I attached a short Redwood SIG summary that highlights where we typically provide evidence; that should speed things up. If 2 business days is your required turnaround, we'll prioritize it but may request a short extension on any questions requiring legal review.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Summary.pdf (PDF)

Best,
